laws.rule: The Siddens Bening Hands Free Law (RSMo 304.822) bans every driver from holding or supporting a phone or other device, texting, reading messages, making non-hands-free calls, browsing, or watching or recording video while driving. Voice and hands-free use is allowed. Police can't stop a driver for this alone; it is added when a driver is stopped for something else. Warnings only until 1 January 2025; tickets since then.
laws.penalty_signal: Up to US$150 first offence, US$250 second, US$500 third within 24 months (about A$213, A$355 and A$710 at RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040); up to US$500 in a marked work or school zone.

items.text: Adults 21 and over may buy up to 3 ounces (about 85 g) in one sale at a licensed dispensary and may possess up to 3 ounces at any time. No one may use marijuana in a public place unless a local government has set up an area where it is allowed.
Missouri dispensaries may accept medical patient cards issued by other states.
